purpose: Third independent 240-trial dataset, matching the completed RTX 3090 corrected-harness replication; only hardware-specific GPU properties and the newly authorized two-hour allocation budget differ.
runner_change: Preserve assistant reasoning_content alongside content and tool_calls when replaying tool-call history.

sampling.seed_rule: Frozen assignment seed plus zero-based tool turn index

system_ram_measurement: Container cgroup v2 memory.current or cgroup v1 memory.usage_in_bytes; host MemAvailable fallback only if no cgroup counter exists.
checkpointing: New independent database and raw-trace directory; same v2 runner schema and at-most-once interruption handling as the RTX 3090 replication.
